title: AI-assisted document drafting chat (ANDS Studio dossier builder)
walkthrough:
You open a dossier inside "ANDS Studio". A top bar shows the product name, five module tabs (M1 through M5, each with a status dot), and chips for "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio", and "Journey". Down the left runs a section tree for the current module: each row shows a status glyph (circle, half-circle, check), the eCTD section number, its title, and a small "req" or "opt" badge. Sections that don't apply sit under a collapsed "Not required for this generic" list.

Clicking a section opens a panel on the right. It states the module and section number, the section title, a purpose line, and a boxed explainer headed "What Health Canada needs here", with accepted formats, a "Bilingual: EN + FR" tag where relevant, and a link "Health Canada guidance ↗". Below sits an action bar of tabs: "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A".

You click "✦ Author in-app". If the section supports AI drafting (this is per-section; there is no visible cue in the tree — you only find out after opening the tab), a second toggle appears: "💬 Draft with AI" versus "✦ Sample & edit". The AI mode is preselected. Its intro reads: "Chat with an AI assistant to draft this document — it will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks. Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft." The empty thread shows "Tell it about the submission to get started — it knows what" followed by the section's name and "needs."

You type into a two-line box whose placeholder is "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example" and press Enter or "Send" (the button reads "Thinking…" while the reply streams in as a chat bubble). You can keep chatting until the draft looks right. Once a reply finishes, a "Use this draft →" button appears; clicking it (it shows "Saving…") files the assistant's last message into the section, which then lists the generated document with filename, size, an md5 checksum fragment, the word "authored", and a "Download" link.

If the AI backend isn't configured, sending a message returns: "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Use the standard "Author" button below instead, or ask an admin to configure it." — the fallback is the "✦ Sample & edit" form, whose submit button is actually labelled "Author" plus the section title, e.g. "Author Cover Letter →".
